text:
You need an Excel-based report redesigned into HTML format, and I can help turn that source data into a clean, easy-to-read presentation.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard creation, data cleaning, and data visualization. I focus on making data easier to review, understand, and present clearly, especially when the raw material starts in spreadsheets.

One relevant project I built was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I created one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a single reporting view instead of 14 files, and monthly close reporting went from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data modeling, SQL, Excel work, and a strong focus on making the reporting output simple and actionable.

For your Excel to HTML design job, I can help structure the report so the information is cleanly organized and visually readable in a browser-friendly format. Since the data is already in Excel sheets, I’m comfortable working with spreadsheet-based inputs, cleaning the data where needed, and turning it into a polished report layout that matches the goal of making the content easier to review and share.

My approach is practical and detail-oriented:
- review the Excel sheet structure
- clean and organize the data if needed
- design the report layout for clear presentation
- ensure the final result is easy to read and consistent

I’d be glad to support this project and work with your existing Excel data to create a professional HTML report. If helpful, I can also adapt the structure to highlight the most important parts of the report first.

What should the final HTML report emphasize most: a simple table-style presentation, or a more visual report layout?
